title: Boss: screw bosses joining an enclosure and its lid (M3, counterbore, alignment step)

steps.comment: no drafts and no fillets: every piece is a cylinder

expect.note: Enclosure 60x40x20 shelled 2 (top open) = 48000 - 56*36*18 = 11712; lid 60x40x10 shelled 2 (bottom open) = 24000 - 56*36*8 = 7872. Per point, thread side (enclosure, clearance 0.05): shank r 3.75 from z 19.95 to the floor z 2 (17.95), spigot r 2.9 0.9 high, minus the pilot r 1.2 from the spigot top to 1 mm above the outside (0.9 + 17.95 + 1): pi (3.75^2 17.95 + 2.9^2 0.9 - 1.2^2 19.85) = 726.986138. Head side (lid): shank r 4.5 from z 20.05 to the lid's inside z 28 (7.95), minus the recess r 3 1 deep, the hole r 1.7 for 1 mm, the counterbore r 3.25 from z 22.05 to the outside (7.95): pi (4.5^2 7.95 - 9 - 1.7^2 - 3.25^2 7.95) = 204.598185. Two points. The expect is the lid (the head side's body).
